verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm that sells legal advisory services, not a software product, so opting out of product telemetry or usage tracking is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows only practice-area pages, the Prarambh incubator, internal legaltech adoption and privacy-law commentary. None of it shows a user-facing software product that collects telemetry.
